scope: 26 November 2026 evening, native packed Nylocas room. Two role policies and the controller used by the companion commands.

method.score: Nearest-rank P5 and P95 and arithmetic mean among completed rooms with known zero last-wave-19 population-cap stalls. All trial statuses count toward the deadline rate.
method.pairing: The 250-room retained run repeats the 250 starting control seeds. The 400-room and 500-room holdouts drew independent starting seeds after freezing the policy and used disjoint ranges.
method.coverage: Original NPC keys, actual launches, native hit queues and zero HP/death-queue observations. An original east-15 small is covered once dying, at zero HP or with a lethal rolled hit in flight. Post-coverage wait is the time to the first primary on that role’s parent.
method.south_chin: The first green tick is birth+5. Both original NPCs must receive the same native attack ID three ticks after launch. A zero-damage result is included as an impact.
method.entry_to_wave20: Ticks from the simulator room-entry clock to wave-20 spawn
method.population: The split frame contains both newborns on the original parent’s two tiles. Count every physically present nylo, including dying bodies. A 12-body split frame measures crowding whether or not an admission was due on that tick.

fixture.gear: role loadouts from mage-strategy.md and range-strategy.md; see adapter

ranger_earlier_south_pipe.behavior: With an early mage attack on north, the first south pipe moved from a mean age of 6.45 to 4.89 ticks in the 56 qualifying rooms. Last-wave-16 retries rose from 76 to 93.

mage_cardinal_contact.behavior: The mage spent paid cooldown moving into cardinal contact in 80 rooms. In 200 trials the mage opened on the first policy-ready observation after both smalls were covered in 152 rooms, compared with 135.

deterministic_replays.fix: At 65 HP the ranger deferred a finite manta by one tick, launched a black chin, healed to 87 at tick 266 and dealt 2 and 8 damage on tick 268. Previously it ate at tick 265 and never threw the chin.

The ranger rolled lethal damage on the second east-15 small at tick 114. With coverage observable at tick 115 both parents received attacks on tick 116. The mage previously reached its parent on tick 117.
The east-21 chin left a 4-HP original. A blowpipe shot at 179 landed at 181, and west 22 opened at 184. The previous west-22 opener was 188.
The mage killed west 26 with Eye at 237, used Dinh at 244 and killed east 24 with scythe at 249.
West 26 received Eye at 230 and 233 and died, then the east-24 parent died from the scheduled Dinh at 241.
The mage moved in from the west, kept the tick-260 Eye and used scythe on south 29 at 263. The parent died at 264.
